attribution.title: Pakhuis Afrika, Jollemanhof 19, Amsterdam (A.J. Joling 1915, remodelled 1935; extended 2009)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012087187 (CC0). It shows the warehouse's concrete frame on brick with red-framed windows, the tilted steel and grey slatted balconies, and the loading platform on the IJ. On the city side it shows the arcade and the AFRIKA letters, the dark gap with raking struts under the cantilevered block, and the mottled grey and salmon skin with its irregular windows on the block and the tower. All of it is read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
